title: Co-evolution of RcsD and RcsF shapes signal transduction in the enterobacteriaceae Rcs system.
authors: Dapour, Abdelraouf O; Shehata, Moustafa; Siam, Rania; Hussein, Nahla A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究细菌Rcs信号转导系统中RcsD与RcsF的共进化及功能耦合，使用分子对接和MD模拟预测蛋白相互作用，虽对象非典型蛋白质结构计算核心，但结构建模与模拟方法可迁移至蛋白质体系。
abstract: Two-component systems (TCS) formed of sensor histidine kinases (HK) and response regulators (RR) are the primary prokaryotic signal transduction pathways. In Enterobacteriaceae, some TCS evolved architectural complexity, by integrating auxiliary proteins into the HK- RR dyad. The Regulator of Capsule Synthesis (Rcs), a conserved phosphorelay system in Enterobacteriaceae, recruits several auxiliary proteins, including an outer membrane lipoprotein, RcsF, which senses cell envelope threats and transduces the signal to downstream components. A second auxiliary protein located in the inner membrane, RcsD, transfers the phosphoryl group from the hybrid histidine kinase RcsC to the response regulator RcsB. RcsD is formed of a large periplasmic domain (Asn43-Asn308) sandwiched between two transmembrane helices and a cytosolic domain. For RcsD, the role and evolutionary benefit of maintaining a large periplasmic domain while the main phosphostransfer reaction occurs in the cytosol is not clear. Here, we show that RcsF and RcsD exhibit strong co-evolutionary coupling independent of host speciation (partial Mantel r = 0.950, p < 0.0001). Structure-guided docking and 500-ns molecular dynamics simulations predicted a stable interaction between RcsF and RcsD (MM-GBSA DeltaG  approximately  -95 kcal/mol), suggesting their functional coupling. Functional assays in Escherichia coli K12 MG1655 revealed that RcsD periplasmic domain represses basal Rcs activity in unstressed cells (~5-fold derepression) yet is essential for stress-induced activation (1.9-2.5-fold). Overexpression of rcsF beyond the chromosomal level induces Rcs signal activation only when the RcsD periplasmic domain is present. These findings demonstrate how co-evolution of an auxiliary protein generates novel regulatory function in the Rcs phosphorelay and provide insights into the role of RcsD periplasmic domain in stress signal transduction.
abstract_zh: 由传感器组氨酸激酶（HK）和响应调节器（RR）组成的双组分系统（TCS）是原核生物主要的信号转导途径。在肠杆菌科中，一些TCS通过将辅助蛋白整合到HK-RR二元组中，演化出了结构上的复杂性。荚膜合成调节器（Rcs）是肠杆菌科中一个保守的磷酸中继系统，它招募多种辅助蛋白，包括一种外膜脂蛋白RcsF，该蛋白感知细胞包膜威胁并将信号传导至下游组分。另一种位于内膜的辅助蛋白RcsD，将磷酸基团从杂合组氨酸激酶RcsC转移至响应调节器RcsB。RcsD由一个大的周质结构域（Asn43-Asn308）夹在两个跨膜螺旋和一个胞质结构域之间组成。对于RcsD而言，在主要磷酸转移反应发生在胞质中的情况下，维持一个大的周质结构域的作用和进化优势尚不清楚。在此，我们表明RcsF和RcsD表现出强烈的共进化耦合，且独立于宿主物种形成（部分Mantel r = 0.950，p < 0.0001）。结构引导的对接和500纳秒分子动力学模拟预测了RcsF与RcsD之间的稳定相互作用（MM-GBSA DeltaG 约 -95 kcal/mol），提示它们的功能耦合。在大肠杆菌K12 MG1655中的功能测定显示，RcsD周质结构域在无应激细胞中抑制基础Rcs活性（约5倍去抑制），但对应激诱导的激活（1.9-2.5倍）至关重要。仅当RcsD周质结构域存在时，rcsF的过表达超过染色体水平才会诱导Rcs信号激活。这些发现展示了辅助蛋白的共进化如何在Rcs磷酸中继中产生新的调控功能，并为RcsD周质结构域在应激信号转导中的作用提供了见解。
